about_short_description.short_description: ShopBrain is a cloud-based operations management system that helps F&B businesses improve their back-of-house operations.

product.name: Procurement and Supply Management System
product.description: A cloud-based system to manage the entire purchasing process from order creation to receipt, supplier management, and invoice tracking.

product.name: Inventory Management Module
product.description: A module to monitor real-time stock levels, automate item costing, track transfers, and manage inventory alerts to maintain optimal stock.

product.name: Production and Consumption Planning Module
product.description: A tool to plan food production by calculating ingredient quantities based on menu items and portions, including waste tracking and preparation guidelines.

product.name: Sales and Forecasting Module
product.description: A forecasting tool that analyzes sales data to predict demand variability influenced by seasonal patterns and marketing campaigns.

product.name: Cost Management System
product.description: A system to monitor and control operational costs by forecasting purchase needs and reducing inventory waste using AI-driven insights.
